prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic vertical smartphone selfie of a beautiful young adult East Asian woman sitting inside a cozy Korean-style bedroom. She has porcelain-fair skin, large expressive dark brown eyes, naturally full soft-pink lips, a small straight nose, and delicate oval facial features. Her medium-length dark brown hair is slightly messy with airy wispy bangs and loose strands naturally framing her face, creating a fresh just-woke-up appearance.
She gently tilts her head to one side while touching and tucking her hair behind one ear with her free hand. She looks directly into the phone camera with a subtle romantic smile and a soft, relaxed expression. She wears an oversized fuzzy knitted navy-blue off-shoulder sweater that casually slips down from one shoulder, naturally revealing her shoulder and collarbone. The sweater has realistic fluffy wool fibres, loose folds, and oversized sleeves.
The background features a white bookshelf filled with books, glowing candles, small decorative glass jars, framed artwork, vintage-style photographs, cute room accessories, and a subtle green plant. Warm natural indoor ambient light is mixed with soft golden candlelight, creating gentle shadows and a cozy aesthetic atmosphere.
Captured casually at arm’s length using a modern smartphone, slightly above eye level, 26mm-equivalent mobile-camera lens, vertical 9:16 composition, mild realistic wide-angle distortion, authentic exposure, automatic white balance, slight smartphone HDR processing, tiny sensor noise, realistic skin pores, fine facial baby hairs, natural individual hair strands, and slightly imperfect everyday social-media framing.
Add small handwritten Korean romantic text near the lower-left area:
“오늘도 보고싶어 ♡”
Use a delicate cream-white handwritten Korean font. No professional studio lighting, no beauty filter, no excessive makeup, no plastic skin, no unrealistic facial proportions, no obvious AI-generated appearance, natural candid Korean lifestyle selfie, ultra-photorealistic.

promptZh: 一张超写实的竖屏智能手机自拍，画面中是一位美丽的东亚年轻女性，坐在 温馨的韩式卧室 里。她拥有瓷白细腻的皮肤、明亮深邃的棕色大眼睛、自然饱满的淡粉色嘴唇、小巧挺直的鼻梁以及精致的鹅蛋脸。她中等长度的深棕色头发略显凌乱，空气刘海和几缕发丝自然地垂在脸颊两侧，营造出一种清新的“刚睡醒”感。她微微歪着头，一只手轻轻撩起头发别在耳后。她直视手机镜头，带着淡淡的浪漫微笑，表情柔和放松。她穿着一件 超大款毛绒海军蓝露肩针织毛衣，毛衣从一侧肩膀自然滑落，露出肩部和锁骨。毛衣呈现出真实的绒毛质感、自然的褶皱和宽松的袖口。背景中有一个白色的书架，上面摆放着书籍、发光的蜡烛、精致的小玻璃罐、艺术画框、复古照片、可爱的房间装饰品以及一株小绿植。温暖的室内自然光与柔和的金色烛光交织，营造出柔和的阴影和温馨的氛围。画面由现代智能手机以手臂距离拍摄，略高于视线水平，采用 26mm 等效手机镜头，9:16 竖屏构图，带有轻微真实的广角畸变、真实的曝光、自动白平衡、轻微的手机 HDR 处理、细微的传感器噪点、真实的皮肤毛孔、细小的面部绒毛、自然的单根发丝，以及略显随意的社交媒体构图。在左下角添加一行手写的韩文浪漫文字：“오늘도 보고싶어 ♡”，使用精致的奶油白色手写韩文字体。拒绝专业摄影棚灯光，拒绝美颜滤镜，拒绝浓妆艳抹，拒绝塑料感皮肤，拒绝不切实际的面部比例，拒绝明显的 AI 生成感，呈现自然真实的韩式生活自拍，超写实画质。
